label: 🔢 NumPy array
description: Read NumPy .npy (single array) and .npz (zip of named arrays). 1-D arrays become a single column; 2-D arrays become N columns named col_1, col_2, … (or the array's structured-dtype field names if present). For .npz, the 'name' option picks which array to load — defaults to the first 2-D one.

name.label: Array name (.npz only)
name.help: Which array inside the .npz to load. Default: the first 2-D array, or the first array if none are 2-D.
